The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. We need to fill to full capacity. We need to know current fuel level in gallons. 10 liters is about 2.641 gallons (1 liter = 0.264172 gallons). So we need to add 50 - 2.641 = 47.359 gallons. But we might just fill to 50 gallons. The function fillFuelTank takes fuelAmount: float. It says "This is the additional fuel to add to the tank." So we need to add 47.359 gallons. Let's compute precisely: 10 liters * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So remaining capacity = 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. We'll round maybe to 47.36 gallons. Use fillFuelTank.
